_doc: Accepted data-flow exceptions for scripts/check-data-flows.ts. 'global' = registrable domains accepted everywhere; 'perIntegration' = hosts accepted for a specific integration id. Every other contacted host is disclosed by a dataSources[].url, a dataSources[].apiHosts entry (the real data-API host when it differs from the portal url), or the gate's built-in allowlist of shared/license/own-infra hosts. The entries below are the reviewed exceptions: search-nlp's optional cloud LLM providers, and openconditions.org, the link of the OpenConditions crowd credit, which is not a registered data source. Add entries here only for a genuine exception you've reviewed.
